retention_policy: Run exactly six registered policy/scenario combinations and two derived CASH accounts. Retain each unresolved native split/exposure incident with null economic PnL, full details/reservation, and continue the other registered combinations. No ex-post event filtering, altered data, new policy or rescue optimization.
incomplete_family: Any missing report/control means whole-family statistical gates are not evaluable. Do not substitute zero returns. Include all incidents and report map in exact reproduction hashes.
split_path: Known original action lineage includes XLK split 2025-12-05. Native engine does not model inventory across this split. A crossing path remains a fail-closed incident; missing announcement knownAt is not invented to skip trades.
